facts.fact: A BCEAO decision published on 25 June 2026 set 30 September 2026 as the deadline for banks, e-money institutions and payment institutions of the WAEMU to complete connection to PI-SPI and open services to the public.

systems.tiers: banks, e-money institutions, payment institutions, microfinance institutions; 20 participants in Burkina Faso at 30 September 2026
